summary:
The record is consistent with revision r3 after my repairs. The strict build passes with no warning, `check.mjs` ends with "All checks passed" (148 pass lines), and the feedback mechanics pass on the served page and on the dist file.

Skills loaded after `git remote -v` (origin is github.com/ariakit/visonaut): `ariakit-general-workflow`, `ariakit-general-code-style`. No visonaut-specific skill is installed.

**The main results**

1. **Length.** Section 15 now has 7,218 reader words against 7,223 in r2 (the editor left 8,111). It has 1,635 lines against 1,649. Its rendered height is 13,305 px at 1440 px (r2: 15,508) and 22,774 px at 400 px (r2: 27,763). The file has 71,104 bytes against 70,768, because of 5 new comment lines that the page does not show.
2. **One dependency was missing in the record, and one sentence of the editor was too strong.** The service compares a third pinned value that the D-OPS-04 texts do not name: the package digest of the capture adapter.

```jsonc
// apps/web/wrangler.jsonc:62 (service)
"VISONAUT_TRUSTED_EXECUTOR_DIGEST": "be4439ac7ce5eccea7b0d253687cae53b114884deed179d9dd17fd966b722e22",
```
```yaml
# .github/workflows/app.yml:11 of ariakit/ariakit (saved copy of the data-02 lane)
VISONAUT_PACKAGE_SHA256: be4439ac7ce5eccea7b0d253687cae53b114884deed179d9dd17fd966b722e22
```
```ts
// apps/web/src/api/workflow-owned.ts:500-501: another digest gives 403 manifest_provenance
!context.configuration.trustedExecutorDigest ||
!isTrustedWorkflowExecutor(context.configuration, discovery.executorDigest) ||
```
   So "this is the last pin cutover" and "the pin runbook goes away" are true for the two workflow pins only. Section 15 now says so. The option text and the lane part of D-OPS-04 do not (item for the coordinator).
3. **Status claims.** Outside `70-design-lab.html` I found no false status claim after the editor. `70-design-lab.html:318-322` still says that D-WORK-04 is open (item for the coordinator).
4. **Numbers.** Each number of the two answers in section 15 agrees with the verify files, the lane parts, and the option texts. `10-summary.html` has counts only, and they are right (50 settled, 2 open).
5. **The D1 rule.** 4 places in sections and 3 rationales in decisions.json still said "D1 writes must not increase". They now say "D1 writes that repeat must not increase". 2 places inside the D-OPS-04 lane part keep the old words (not edited, reported).

Files changed by me: `sections/15-your-answers.html`, `35-state-checks.html` (line 543 only, outside the lane part), `40-data-storage.html` (line 809 only, outside the lane part), `60-workspace-viewer.html` (2 sentences), `65-resilience-a11y.html` (3 sentences), `decisions.json` (3 rationales, 2 words each). feedbackMechanics:
Tested in Chrome with Playwright (script `mechanics.mjs`, a new context for each case), on http://127.0.0.1:4320/audit/index.html and on the file URL of `apps/lab/audit/dist/visonaut-audit.html`. Both runs: 0 failed checks, 0 console errors.

**Storage.** Key `visonaut-audit:feedback` in localStorage. Format (engine/core.js:1081-1174):

```json
{ "revision": "r3", "baseline": { "D-OPS-04": { "selection": null, "notes": "..." } }, "current": { "...": {} } }
```

**New profile.** The bar says "50 / 52 answered", revision r3. The Decisions menu has 52 entries in the order of the panels. 50 say "Answered · settled in the record", and D-OPS-04 and D-DATA-02 say "Open". Both open panels have no checked option and show the notes of record.json. Each has one visible label Recommended (`no-file-check`, `row-pages-staged`), not selected. Each of the 52 panels shows the selection, the notes, and the Recommended labels of the data. The prompt lists no decision: "No decision changed in this feedback round (0 of 52)", "Revision: r3 (2026-10-06)".

**After one selection (D-OPS-04 `no-file-check`) and one note (D-DATA-02).** The bar says "51 / 52 answered". The prompt lists exactly D-OPS-04 and D-DATA-02 ("2 of 52") and names revision r3. Copy: the clipboard equals the prompt, the status says "Prompt copied. It has 2 updated decisions: D-OPS-04, D-DATA-02.", and the stored baseline is the same object as before (D-OPS-04 baseline `null`). After a reload: the same prompt text, the same selection, the same note.

**A browser with saved r2 feedback.** I wrote an r2 state (revision "r2", the r2 baseline, the round 2 answers in `current`) and loaded the page again.
- Case A, what the maintainer had (`paged-objects` for D-DATA-02, D-OPS-04 with no selection): the bar says "50 / 52 answered". The removed option does not count. D-DATA-02 is Open with no checked option, keeps the note, and shows: "Your earlier selection (paged-objects) is not an option in this revision. The decision is open again. Your notes are kept. Select a current option to answer it." The menu says "Open · changed". The prompt lists D-DATA-02 only (1 of 52): "Answer: OPEN. Reason: the earlier selection `paged-objects` is no longer an option in revision r3." The stored state becomes revision r3 with the r3 baseline and `stale: { selection: "paged-objects", revision: "r3" }`.
- Case B, also `service-workflow` for D-OPS-04: that option still exists, so it stays selected and counts ("51 / 52 answered", menu "Answered · changed"). The prompt lists D-OPS-04 (Answer: option `service-workflow`, answer in the record: OPEN) and D-DATA-02 (OPEN). This is the acceptable behavior that the task names.
- D-WORK-04, D-RES-06, D-RES-05, and D-DATA-04 show no change in both cases, because the saved answers equal the r3 baseline.
The page does not break and needs no patch in build.mjs or in the engine.

**Menu jump.** Each of the two open entries scrolls to its panel, closes the menu, and moves focus to the panel. The panel top is 16 px below the bar at both widths (1440 px: 69 against 53; 400 px: 129 against 113). No sideways scroll.
